page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 64 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core, providing a total of 64 vCPUs. It is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of memory per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong multi-core performance, particularly in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and stress-ng multi-core CPU tests. Its memory subsystem shows high read-only bandwidth for large uncached blocks, and it scores in the top tier for PassMark database operations and extended instruction tests. Conversely, single-core operations, static web serving, and Redis SET operations perform in the average tier, while large language model text generation speeds fall into the lower quartile.

Given its high compute-to-memory ratio and dedicated core allocation, the ecs.hfc6.16xlarge offers high resource density for compute-heavy workloads. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a specialized choice where raw CPU execution and memory bandwidth are prioritized over local disk I/O or hardware acceleration. It is well-suited for multi-threaded batch processing, database operations, and CPU-bound computational tasks.
